_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost...

description:
Best for: "what will import duty and VAT be on this?" for one item shipped to the UK, US or EU.
Returns: duty, VAT, US fees and total, plus trade_defence, chapter_99, complete, missing, sources and notes. When hs_code is a heading with several final lines, line_range prices each rated line and names the lowest and the highest; the top-level fields are then the low line's.
Input tips: hs_code (UK or EU 10 digits, US 8 or 10), destination, goods_value, shipping, and currency when given. Never guess origin, transport or country: omit what the user did not state.

country.description: EU member state for the VAT rate, such as DE (EU destination). Omit if not stated.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of goods_value and shipping, such as USD. They are converted to GBP (UK), USD (US) or EUR (EU) at the latest ECB reference rate, so the low-value thresholds are checked in their own currency.

destination.description: Where the goods are imported: "UK", "US" or "EU". EU duty comes from TARIC.

goods_value.description: Value of the goods, such as 80, in currency (or in the destination's currency when currency is omitted).

hs_code.description: A tariff code, UK or EU (TARIC) 10 digits or US 8 or 10 digits, dots allowed, such as "6109100010". Copy it from bulk_hs_candidates. A candidate, not binding. A heading with several final lines (such as a 6-digit subheading) is answered as a range: every rated line under it is priced and the lowest and highest are named in line_range.

origin.description: 2-letter country the goods were made in (such as CN or VN). Omit when the user did not state a country of origin; never guess or infer origin from the language of the prompt. A partial call without origin returns the base duty with complete: false and missing.

shipping.description: Shipping and insurance to the destination, such as 12, in the same currency. Send 0 if none.

transport.description: How the goods travel into the US (ocean adds the 0.125% harbor fee; air and other add none). Omit when the user did not state transport; never guess. A partial call without transport returns complete: false and missing.

name: landed_cost_estimate

chapter_99.description: US only: extra chapter 99 duties that were added. They are already counted in duty; do not add them again.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

chapter_99_skipped.description: US only: chapter 99 headings that matched but were not added, each with the reason.

reason.description: Why the heading was added or skipped.

complete.description: false when a part could not be worked out; then say what missing or notes list.

currency.description: Present when currency was given: the conversion every amount went through.

rate.description: Units of to per 1 unit of from.

to.description: The destination's currency, which every amount is in.

duty.description: Duty in the answer's currency (currency.to when currency was given). amount is null when the rate is not a plain percentage. Rate and amount already include the chapter_99 lines (US) and the applied trade_defence lines (UK, EU).

basis.description: The value the rate applies to, or "not calculated".

rate.description: The rate applied. With extra duties it reads like 16.5% general + 20% chapter 99 = 36.5% or 4.00% third country + 36.10% anti-dumping = 40.1%.

fees.description: US only: merchandise processing fee (MPF) and harbor fee (HMF).

hs_status.description: Always a candidate code, not a binding classification.

line_range.description: Set when hs_code was a heading with several final lines: the answer is a range, not one figure. Every rated line under the heading was priced on the same input. low and high name the two ends and are absent when no line's duty can be calculated as an amount. unpriced names every final line the range does not cover with the reason (cap, read_failed, no_rate, not_ad_valorem), and all_lines_priced is then false. All totals are in the answer's currency (currency.to when currency was given). The top-level hs_code, duty, vat and total are the low line's.

all_lines_priced.description: true only when every final line under the heading was priced with a calculated duty, so low and high bound the whole heading.

heading.description: The heading that was sent, not a final line.

high.description: The line with the highest total, present only when at least two lines have a calculated duty; with one such line it is the single low.

complete.description: false when that line's total leaves out a part.

duty_rate.description: The duty rate on that line, with chapter 99 or trade defence duties already combined, as duty.rate spells them out.

total.description: Landed total for that line, on the same goods and shipping, in the answer's currency.

lines.description: Every priced line, lowest total first.

complete.description: false when that line's total leaves out a part.

duty_rate.description: The duty rate on that line, with chapter 99 or trade defence duties already combined, as duty.rate spells them out.

total.description: Landed total for that line, on the same goods and shipping, in the answer's currency.

complete.description: false when that line's total leaves out a part.

duty_rate.description: The duty rate on that line, with chapter 99 or trade defence duties already combined, as duty.rate spells them out.

total.description: Landed total for that line, on the same goods and shipping, in the answer's currency.

priced_lines.description: How many final lines under it carried a rate and were priced.

unpriced.description: Every final line the range does not cover, with the reason. Empty when all_lines_priced is true.

reason.description: cap: past the number of lines priced per call. read_failed: its tariff read failed. no_rate: read, with no rate. not_ad_valorem: its duty is not a plain percentage, so no amount is calculated and it cannot be a bound.

missing.description: What is missing when complete is false.

total.description: Goods, shipping, duty, fees and VAT, in currency.to when currency was given, else in the input currency. Leaves out parts that are null. With line_range it is the low line's total.

total_in_input_currency.description: The total converted back to currency.from.

trade_defence.description: UK and EU only: anti-dumping, countervailing, additional and safeguard duties for the origin. Applied lines are already counted in duty; do not add them again.

amount.description: Duty in the answer's currency (currency.to when currency was given), already counted in duty; null when not added.

applied.description: true when the amount is in duty and total.

area.description: Origin the measure applies to, such as CN.

basis.description: Which rate was used and why, or why it was not added.

exporter_rates.description: Named exporters with their own rate, and the range of those rates.

legal_act.description: Link to the act that set the duty.

measure.description: Measure as the tariff names it, such as Definitive anti-dumping duty.

rate.description: Rate for exporters without a rate of their own, or null when the tariff lists only named exporters.

vat.description: VAT in the answer's currency (currency.to when currency was given), on goods, shipping and duty. 0 for the US.

title: Estimate duty, VAT and landed cost
